target=$1
if [ -z "$target" ]; then target=10.10.0.11; fi
echo "Scanning $target..."
for port in 22 80 443 8080 8443 3306 5432 7001 8081 8082 8083 8084 8085 8086 8087 8088 8089 8090 8443 9000 9090 9200 9443; do
  timeout 1 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/$target/$port" 2>/dev/null && echo "Port $port open"
done
